title: Practice: Spinning Back Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's spinning back heel kick. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Kickboxing › Spinning Back Kick: cues, mistakes, next). Karate: ushiro geri (後ろ蹴り); Thai: te klap lang (เตะกลับหลัง). Footage: the owner's clip 22 (ring, 2026-11-02), raw-footage/practice/p22.mp4, two shots joined in InShot (cut at 7.0 s): a slow rep with a long hold facing away (turn at 1.0 s, kick at 4.3–4.9 s), then one at full speed (spin at 9.4 s, kick at 9.8–10.1 s).

props.hookSub: Spinning back kick. Ushiro geri. 20 seconds.

cues.label: SPOT
cues.say: Coach: "The head turns first. Find the target over your shoulder before the leg moves."

cues.label: CHAMBER
cues.say: Coach: "Knee up and tight to the body as you come round. A loose leg swings wide."

cues.label: HEEL
cues.say: Coach: "Straight back like a mule kick, heel first. Not an arc."

watch.fix: Eyes on the target, then kick
watch.label: SPOT
watch.say: Coach: "Spin blind and you kick air, or a counter. Eyes first, heel second."

Watch for: spinning without spotting the target.
